parallel.implementation: The visible work stayed in executable probing, corpus mining, and behavior specification; no final JavaScript library or entry implementation was produced.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No component results were aggregated into a deliverable and artifact validation found no files in the required output artifact directory.
parallel.verification: Many black-box probes were run by the parent and children, but no integrated Node.js implementation was tested against the executable or evaluator.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The required test4.mjs was missing at closure, the workflow state was killed with null result, and official evaluation passed 0 of 161 samples.

serial.plan_and_ownership: A single parent owned the whole effort, using sequential local probes and background shell work without workflow, task, or subagent delegation.
serial.implementation: The serial run built probe helpers and keyword lists but did not create the requested JavaScript port before timeout.
serial.integration_and_delivery: No /output library modules or test4.mjs entry file were present for artifact collection.
serial.verification: The serial run verified many executable behaviors but never reached integrated JS verification because no implementation was delivered.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The required test4.mjs was absent, process timeout occurred, and official evaluation passed 0 of 161 samples.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluation is not discordant: both the parallel and serial runs failed with 0 of 161 samples passing. The immediate evaluator-facing reason is identical for both runs: artifact validation found no files and no test4.mjs, so neither submitted an implementation. The process difference is that parallel spent much of its budget on a killed multi-agent workflow and suffered a helper-file collision, while serial spent its single-agent budget on local probing without delegation.
parallel_contributors: Parallel launched a broad workflow of probe and keyword agents that was killed with no aggregate result.
Parallel had a same-file helper collision in /tmp/probe that forced parent rework.
serial_contributors: Serial had no workflow or child coordination, but still spent the full run on probes and did not produce the required output file.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Neither run produced a JavaScript implementation, so no algorithmic code could be evaluated.
Both failures include ordinary task-management failure to stop probing and create the deliverable.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained patterns are parallel adverse process consequences only
